AuditConditionValue.description:
One section under one assignment condition.

`molecules` counts the result's molecules in the population kept under the condition; retention divides it
by the default condition's count. Each excess drop is its expectation minus the observed value.
AuditConditionValue.title: AuditConditionValue

AuditMetrics.description:
Retention and excluded molecules for one scope of a section under one assignment condition.

A scope is the whole section (cell_type and gene are null), one cell type (gene is null), or one gene
within one cell type. Retention is the share of default-condition molecules the condition keeps; it is
null, with a reason, when the scope has no default-condition molecules.
AuditMetrics.title: AuditMetrics

genes.description: One gene, or a gene pair for co-expression.

eligible_section_ids.description: Sections with at least 20 cells of the population and 10 of the result's molecules in them under the default condition; pooled values and the label use only these.

AuditSectionValues.description:
One section of an audit result. `cells_labelled` is the fixed population count: cells carrying the
label under the default condition. A cell without retained molecules stays in every denominator.
AuditSectionValues.title: AuditSectionValues

CacheInput.description:
A computed input a model request was built from. Part of the cache key, so a changed tool version
or artifact invalidates the stored response.
CacheInput.title: CacheInput

CapabilityCheck.description: One analysis and whether this dataset supports it, with the reason.
CapabilityCheck.title: CapabilityCheck

CapabilityReport.description: For a dataset, which analyses are supported, unavailable or descriptive only, each with its reason.

contrasts.description: The inference eligibility of every contrast the dataset allows.

CapabilityReport.title: CapabilityReport

nucleus_radius.description: Radius of a circle with the nucleus's area: an approximation.

ChainCheckResult.description: The outcome of checking an audit log's hash chain. `first_bad_seq` is the first entry that fails.
ChainCheckResult.title: ChainCheckResult

CitedNumber.description: One number the claim's text uses, and the field of the cited finding it comes from.
CitedNumber.title: CitedNumber

ClaimControls.description: Ids of the controls the claim cites; a required control that is missing fails verification.
ClaimControls.title: ClaimControls

ClaimDraft.description: The claim-drafting model's structured output: the sentence and every number it uses.
ClaimDraft.title: ClaimDraft

ConditionEffect.description: The difference between group means of the log2 values under one condition.
ConditionEffect.title: ConditionEffect

ConditionName.description: An assignment condition: a rule that decides which molecules count toward a cell (ADR-0002).
ConditionName.title: ConditionName

Contrast.description: One disease group compared with the control group, for example DKD vs Control.
Contrast.title: Contrast

ContrastEligibility.description:
Whether one contrast's groups support statistical inference. In this release every contrast is
descriptive only, because GEO does not map sections to donors (ADR-0007). Donors are never inferred from
expression.

disease_donors_published.description: Donors in the disease group, from the paper's published counts.

control_donors_published.description: Donors in the control group, from the paper's published counts.

excluded_section_ids.description: Sections of either group left out of the contrast, each named with its reason in inference_reason.

ContrastEligibility.title: ContrastEligibility

DatasetFilters.description: The quality and panel filters every validated molecule passed.
DatasetFilters.title: DatasetFilters

DatasetManifest.description: Provenance of a dataset: where it came from, its files, panel and sections.

label_rule_ids.description: Frozen label rules; the first is the default.

DatasetManifest.title: DatasetManifest

EventBase.description:
Fields every event carries. `seq` starts at 1 and increases by one per event within an
investigation; `recorded_at_utc` is when the event was first recorded and never changes on replay.
EventBase.title: EventBase

EvidenceRegion.description: A region ranked by the result's ranking rule as showing the molecules behind it (rank 1 is first).
EvidenceRegion.title: EvidenceRegion

EvidenceStatus.description: An evidence label. It says what the evidence supports, never whether a finding is biologically true.
EvidenceStatus.title: EvidenceStatus

FindingRef.description: The one finding a claim cites.
FindingRef.title: FindingRef

InjectedError.description: Whether this claim is a deliberately altered copy used to test verification. Always shown when true.
InjectedError.title: InjectedError

InvestigationSnapshot.description: The current state of one investigation, including every event emitted so far.
InvestigationSnapshot.title: InvestigationSnapshot

InvestigationState.description: state.json in the investigation's directory; events.jsonl beside it holds every event.
InvestigationState.title: InvestigationState

LabelCounts.description: One section's cells counted by cell type label under each rule, and the cells whose label differs.

cell_types.description: Per label rule id, cells per cell type label.

differing.description: Cells per 'first-rule label -> second-rule label' change.

LabelCounts.title: LabelCounts

LabelRule.description: A frozen, named rule that assigns cell type labels from marker counts under the default condition.

markers.description: Marker genes per cell type, in tie-break order.

ignored_genes.description: Genes the rule never reads when it decides membership.

score_threshold.description: A cell's top marker score (count / gene scale) must reach this.

min_molecules.description: A cell with fewer default molecules is labelled 'Low quality'.

LabelRule.title: LabelRule

LabelRuleSet.description: The frozen label rules of a dataset, the gene scales they use, and per-section label counts.

gene_scales.description: Mean default molecules of each gene per expressing cell, pooled over the scale sections.

LabelRuleSet.title: LabelRuleSet

LeaveOneSectionOut.description: The effect recomputed without one section, and whether its direction survives.
LeaveOneSectionOut.title: LeaveOneSectionOut

ModeInfo.description: How the server answers questions. Live runs arrive with ticket 03.
ModeInfo.title: ModeInfo

ModelCallRecord.description: One model call as the audit log records it, including whether its response was live or replayed.
ModelCallRecord.title: ModelCallRecord

ModelRequest.description:
Everything sent to a provider. Its content hash keys the cache and the replay (ADR-0003),
so it must never contain ids, timestamps or other run-specific values.
ModelRequest.title: ModelRequest

MoleculeColumns.description: One entry per molecule, column by column, so a whole section ships compactly.

cell_index.description: Index into the cell columns; -1 for an unassigned molecule.

included.description: Per condition, 1 if the molecule counts toward its cell under that condition, else 0.

MoleculeColumns.title: MoleculeColumns

PackageInfo.description: What the UI needs to offer an evidence package for download.
PackageInfo.title: PackageInfo

PackageManifest.description: manifest.json inside the evidence package: what it contains and how it was produced.
PackageManifest.title: PackageManifest

PackedColumn.description: One column as a base64 string of little-endian values, decoded straight into a typed array.
PackedColumn.title: PackedColumn

PackedMoleculeColumns.description: Every molecule of the view, one typed column each.
PackedMoleculeColumns.title: PackedMoleculeColumns

PackedRegionView.description:
A region view in typed columns, compact enough to ship and draw a whole section of several hundred
thousand molecules at once.
PackedRegionView.title: PackedRegionView

Plan.description: The ordered tool steps proposed for a question; frozen once approved (its hash is then recorded).

plan_hash.description: sha256 of the proposed plan's canonical JSON, set at approval.

Plan.title: Plan

PlanProposal.description: The planner model's structured output, before it is checked against the tool registry.
PlanProposal.title: PlanProposal

Population.description: The cells a result is about: a cell type under a frozen label rule, fixed under the default condition.
Population.title: Population

Recording.description: A recorded investigation's model responses, replayed by content hash of each request.
Recording.title: Recording

Region.description: A rectangular window of a section, in micrometres, that the viewer shows and a claim can point to.
Region.title: Region

RegionView.description: Everything the viewer draws for one region of a section, in micrometres.
RegionView.title: RegionView

ReplayInfo.description: What the replay banner shows about the recording being played.

origin.description: live: recorded from real model calls; hand_authored: written for tests without calling a model.

ReplayInfo.title: ReplayInfo

ReviewDecision.description: The researcher's decision on one claim version; voice decisions need confirmation.
ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

SectionAudit.description: The output artifact of the `audit_section` tool.
SectionAudit.title: SectionAudit

extent.description: Bounding box in micrometres: x0, y0, x1, y1.

name.description: The section's name in its source, for example x2.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the decompressed raw molecule and cell files.

duplicate_of.description: An earlier section whose raw files hold identical content; analyses count only the earlier one.

SectionLog2Value.description: One section's library-size-normalised value, log2(CP10K + 1), under one condition.
SectionLog2Value.title: SectionLog2Value

SectionValidation.description:
What validation did to one section's raw records. Nothing is dropped silently: every molecule read is
kept or counted under exactly one reason, in this order: malformed, duplicate, below quality, not in panel.

malformed_molecules.description: No gene, a non-finite position, quality or nucleus distance, or a nucleus flag other than 0 or 1.

duplicate_molecules.description: A repeated transcript id; the first record is kept.

below_quality.description: Quality score under the dataset's threshold.

not_in_panel.description: A control probe or codeword, not a panel gene.

unassigned_molecules.description: Kept molecules the instrument assigned to no cell.

unmatched_molecules.description: Kept molecules assigned to a cell id missing from the cells table; kept, counted as unassigned.

malformed_cells.description: No id, or a non-finite centroid or cell area.

duplicate_cells.description: A repeated cell id; the first record is kept.

cells_without_molecules.description: Kept cells with no kept molecule; they stay in every denominator.

cells_without_nucleus.description: Kept cells with no detected nucleus (empty nucleus_area).

SectionValidation.title: SectionValidation

StructureMask.description:
The outline of one structure in section coordinates (micrometres), as a closed polygon.

`source` says where the outline came from: drawn by construction in a synthetic fixture, or proposed
by SAM 3.1 from a box prompt (ADR-0005), which the UI must label as a proposal.
StructureMask.title: StructureMask

ToolSpec.description: A tool as the planner sees it in the registry.
ToolSpec.title: ToolSpec

VerificationResult.description: Every check run on one claim version, and the verification status they add up to.
VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
